intro.heading: Graphics backends
intro.summary: LIMEN can run without a GPU or use a separate graphics backend. Choose a driver based on the app and its target platforms.
drivers.heading: Drivers and guides
drivers.row.None.description: Windows, system events, and input. No GPU required.
drivers.row.Vulkan.description: Explicit control over the GPU and graphics resources.
select-driver.heading: Choose a driver at startup
select-driver.paragraph: Platform.init() takes a preferred driver. If you allow multiple backends, LIMEN can fall back to one the system supports. Read Platform.graphicsDriver to see which driver was selected.
select-driver.paragraph2: If your app requires OpenGL, pass a list of supported drivers:
